items.currentPrompt: Edit target: existing enclosed-cabin red-and-cream tricycle sprite. Replace its entire vehicle design with a delightfully shabby old Chinese rural CARGO motor tricycle (农用三蹦子), not a luxury enclosed electric microcar. The comic charm should come naturally from a tiny scruffy motorcycle-style front pulling an oversized long EMPTY drop-side cargo bed, about two thirds of the vehicle length. Exactly THREE wheels mechanically: one single narrow front wheel attached to exposed motorcycle forks and two rear wheels on one axle under the cargo bed, with physically sensible occlusion. Simple open handlebars, one weathered round headlamp, exposed old engine, worn brown saddle with a small repair patch, no enclosed cabin, no windshield, no roof, no sleek LED lamps. Dented faded brick-red painted steel bed with rusty seams, chipped paint, dusty tires, humble hand-welded repairs and one mismatched faded blue side panel. Old but functional and endearing, not destroyed, no smoke or trash. Keep a semi-realistic model-car/product render look consistent with the other vehicles, NOT a flat illustration or SVG. Front three-quarter view facing LOWER LEFT, elevated camera about 20 degrees, whole vehicle isolated centered with generous transparent margins, no crop. True transparent background with only a soft grounded contact shadow. No people, cargo, scenery, text, labels, watermarks, or brand emblems. The vehicle should be comically utilitarian next to a Rolls-Royce and a Xiaomi SU7, recognizable at 180px.
items.prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset: isolated vehicle sprite for a small fixed-view parking website. Use the provided image as shape and vehicle-identity reference, not as a background. Produce ONE Chinese enclosed-cabin three-wheel motor tricycle, red and cream body, high narrow boxy cabin, tiny short rear cargo bed, exactly ONE central front wheel and TWO rear wheels, black windows, roof lamps; preserve the Chinese utility vehicle character. Faithful semi-realistic miniature/model-car appearance, very light simplification only, crisp detailed silhouette that reads at 180px. Front three-quarter view facing toward lower LEFT, camera elevated about 20 degrees so the hood and roof are visible; whole vehicle centered with generous margin, no cropping, all visible wheels grounded at consistent level. Preserve distinctive real vehicle geometry and proportions, clean softly lit product render. Transparent background with a restrained soft contact shadow only. No ground plane, scenery, frame, labels, captions, promotional logos outside the vehicle, or extra vehicles. This is a visual exploration derived from a reference; do not invent a 3D asset.
